name: Guardrails AI
desc: Add input/output validators and structured guarantees to LLMs, with a hub of reusable validators.

name: NeMo Guardrails
desc: Programmable rails for LLM conversational systems, defined in a dedicated modeling language (by NVIDIA).

name: LLM Guard
desc: A security toolkit for LLM interactions: scanners for PII, toxicity, prompt injection, and more, on both input and output.

name: LangKit
desc: An open-source toolkit for monitoring LLMs — extract safety and quality signals from prompts and responses (by WhyLabs).

name: Rebuff
desc: A self-hardening prompt-injection detector that layers heuristics, an LLM check, a vector DB of known attacks, and canary tokens.

name: Vigil
desc: Detect prompt injections, jailbreaks, and other risky inputs before they reach your model.

name: Llama Guard / PurpleLlama
desc: Meta's suite for LLM safety: Llama Guard (input/output classification), Prompt Guard (injection detection), and CyberSecEval benchmarks.

name: Injection Arena
desc: A self-hostable capture-the-flag game for learning prompt-injection defenses against a stack of guardrails.

name: Guidance
desc: A guidance language for constraining generation — interleave control flow, regex, and grammars so the model can only produce valid output.

name: Outlines
desc: Structured generation: force outputs to match a JSON schema, regex, or grammar, guaranteeing shape.

name: Instructor
desc: Structured outputs for LLMs via Pydantic — validate and retry until the response matches your model.

name: Jsonformer
desc: A bulletproof way to generate structured JSON: only the content tokens are sampled, the structure is fixed.

name: Presidio
desc: Detect, redact, mask, and anonymize PII in text and images — the standard for privacy guardrails (by Microsoft).

name: Detoxify
desc: Trained models to score toxicity, threats, and hate in text — a lightweight content-safety filter.

name: garak
desc: The LLM vulnerability scanner — probe a model for jailbreaks, injections, data leakage, and toxicity before you ship (by NVIDIA).

name: DeepTeam
desc: A framework to red-team LLMs and AI agents against 40+ vulnerabilities and attack methods.

name: Giskard
desc: Open-source scanning for LLM agents that surfaces safety and quality vulnerabilities automatically.

name: ModelScan
desc: Scan model files for serialization attacks — the supply-chain guardrail for weights you download.

name: Skill-audit
desc: Security scanner for agent skills: flags prompt-injection, dangerous shell, secret access, and exfiltration before you install a skill.
